chunks: And with this chain of transmission, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Ismāʿīl, from al-Faḍl ibn Shādhān, from Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, who said:
I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about the minimum of what menstruation may be, and he said: “Its minimum is three, and its furthest limit is ten.”

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Abā al-Ḥasan, the Imam عليه السلام being asked about the ruling
key_terms.أَبْعَدُهُ: its furthest limit or maximum extent
key_terms.الْحَيْضِ: menstruation; the legal state discussed in the ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum and maximum duration of menstruation according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling regarding the minimum and maximum duration of hayd (menstruation). It establishes that the least duration of menstruation is three days and its furthest limit is ten days in the jurisprudential context.
